name: cloudy-ai-tokens-go-api
description: Go port of cloudy-ai-tokens-api (the fleet token engine: AES-256-GCM sealed token values, HMAC lookup index, verifier and owner API, audit trail), shadow stage: own sqlite file, own port, outside every request path (ticket #1877). Parity harness drives the Python original with identical requests.

native_build._doc: Multi-stage: compiled in golang:1.24-bookworm on the arch-matched runner, shipped as one static binary on distroless static (no shell, no libc, non-root 65532). No apt/apk line: the base has neither.

build.ship_hold: Shadow stage of the Go port (#1877): code and CI only. Not shipped until the hub is out of memory pressure (#1898) and the parity harness has been green for a release; shipping it earlier would add a second resident process next to the Python original.

api.description: Same contract as cloudy-ai-tokens-api: POST /v1/verify for verifiers, the owner API under /v1/tokens and /v1/audit.

parity-compare.cmd: PYREF=$(ls -d /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11*/x64/bin/python3 2>/dev/null | tail -1); ${PYREF:-python3} -m venv /tmp/tk-parity-venv && /tmp/tk-parity-venv/bin/pip install -q -r ../../../infra-sec_cloudy-ai-tokens-api/src/code/requirements.txt && PY_BIN=/tmp/tk-parity-venv/bin/python PY_APP_DIR=$PWD/../../../infra-sec_cloudy-ai-tokens-api/src/code PARITY_REQUIRE=1 go test -count=1 -timeout 15m -tags parity -v -run TestParity ./parity/
parity-compare._doc: Reference = the Python service main.py (CPython 3.11, Flask 3.0.0) driven by parity/ref.py with a fake clock and a deterministic byte stream; the Go port gets the same. Synthetic fleet key, tokens, introspection upstream and sqlite fixtures; valid, expired, revoked, wrong-audience, tampered-ciphertext, missing and malformed inputs must give identical status, headers, bodies, sqlite rows and upstream calls; AES-256-GCM vectors and the HMAC index are checked both directions.

parity-mutation.cmd: PYREF=$(ls -d /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11*/x64/bin/python3 2>/dev/null | tail -1); ${PYREF:-python3} -m venv /tmp/tk-parity-venv && /tmp/tk-parity-venv/bin/pip install -q -r ../../../infra-sec_cloudy-ai-tokens-api/src/code/requirements.txt && o=$(mktemp); PY_BIN=/tmp/tk-parity-venv/bin/python PY_APP_DIR=$PWD/../../../infra-sec_cloudy-ai-tokens-api/src/code PARITY_MUTATE=1 PARITY_REQUIRE=1 go test -count=1 -timeout 15m -tags parity -run TestParityCorpus ./parity/ >"$o" 2>&1; grep -q 'requests differ' "$o"
parity-mutation._doc: Mutation proof: the Go side is given a different admin client id; the harness must report differing requests.

_doc_addressing: No mesh name on purpose during the shadow stage: nothing dials this container, so it needs no Hickory row and no Caddy fallback-map entry.
